jobs.description: Shape what comes next | Discover careers in Tech At Amazon, our tech isn't just a tool, it's your playground. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer – AI/ML Networking Disaggregated Inference, Annapurna Labs , Elastic Collectives
jobs.description: Every token a large language model generates depends on data reaching the right accelerator at the right moment. As AI models outgrow any single chip, the network between accelerators becomes the bottleneck that decides how fast — and how affordably — the world's largest models can serve real users. That network layer is what our team builds. We're looking for an engineer to work at the frontier of disaggregated inference: splitting LLM serving into separate prefill and decode pools and moving the model's KV cache between them at the limit of what the hardware allows. Get it right and users get answers in milliseconds; get it wrong and the fastest accelerators in the world sit idle waiting on data. You'll build components of the high-speed transfer path that make that difference, and you'll learn to measure success in how close we run to the theoretical peak of the machine. In this role you will: Build and optimize the low-level data-movement software that transfers KV cache and activations across accelerators, servers, and heterogeneous memory — over AWS's highest-performance network fabric. Profile real workloads, find the true bottleneck, and close the gap between "it works" and "it runs fast" — pushing components toward the hardware's limit. Work across the stack — from network transport up to the inference frameworks — learning from the teams building the chips, runtime, and models. Deliver features that ship to our largest clusters, for our largest customers, serving the largest AI models in production. What we're looking for: Strong C/C++ and a genuine interest in low-level, performance-critical systems — solid command of Linux, memory, and writing fast code. The instinct to ask "how fast could this go?" and the discipline to measure it. Exposure to high-speed networking, HPC interconnects, or GPU/accelerator systems (RDMA, InfiniBand, libfabric, UCX, NCCL, MPI) is a strong plus; embedded-systems experience is welcome. Prior AI/ML experience is not required — if you're a strong systems engineer eager to learn, we'll teach you the ML side. If you like solving genuinely hard problems, working alongside HPC and ML customers, iterating fast, and shipping at a scale few places can offer, come join us. You'll work alongside senior engineers and Principal Engineers who've built this layer from the ground up, with real room to grow your scope and technical depth — on a team at the leading edge of AI/ML infrastructure. About the team: You'd be joining Annapurna Labs, an integral part of AWS. Annapurna designs the hardware and software building blocks behind EC2 — every EC2 instance runs on hardware we designed. We specialize in the chips, systems, and software that optimize the AWS customer experience, and this team sits where AI meets the silicon and the network underneath it. A day in the life Annapurna Labs, a crucial part of AWS, is responsible for developing hardware and software components for EC2 infrastructure. Our team focuses on building networking solutions that for Machine Learning (ML) and High-Performance Computing (HPC) workloads on AWS. We have mixed discipline orgs, you’d be working side by side with infrastructure experts, hardware engineers, RTL engineers, scientists & architects. Our workforce spans the globe and is truly international, you’ll find yourself working side by side with individuals from numerous countries. We take mentorship seriously, you can both expect senior mentorship and will be expected to mentor new and junior engineers. The pace is fast as we work on the latest advancements of AI/ML, but we take the time to bond as a team and enjoy the successes. We offer flexibility in working hours, and respect WLB as a core org tenet. The team enjoys working with numerous principal-level engineers and closely with directors, career growth opportunities are certainly available. This is a role where you will always be encouraged to keep learning, the AI/ML field is fast moving and constantly evolving. About the team Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future. Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. Our team tackles the toughest challenges in the semiconductor industry, creating solutions that power everything from smartphones to space exploration. Here, you’ll work alongside brilliant minds, gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge tools, and see your ideas come to life in products that change the world. If you’re passionate about pushing boundaries and making a real difference, this is where you belong. Your future starts here—are you ready to build it with us? Join us in Fremont, CA and work alongside industry leaders solving the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry. You’ll gain hands-on experience, collaborate with brilliant minds, and see your ideas shape the future of technology. The impact you’ll make Launch Your Career as a Process or Product Engineer at Lam! Step into the world of cutting-edge technology and start shaping the future. As a Process Engineer , you’ll work with atomic precision, material science, and surface engineering to push the limits of what’s possible in semiconductor manufacturing. In this role, you’ll: Develop innovative process solutions that power next-generation chips Define equipment hardware to meet advanced processing needs Analyze test data and collaborate on design improvements Ensure seamless integration of breakthrough technologies As a Product Engineer, you thrive in a high-stakes, dynamic environment, driving product development at the forefront of the semiconductor equipment industry. Compile and analyze test data to establish next steps in process development and determine appropriate limits and variables for process specifications. Collaborate internally to plan, collect data, analyze results, and report on customer demos for existing process applications. Support product development from product prototyping, development, deployment/product release, and initial field support. Collaborate with cross-functional and cross-cultural teams to guide the specification and development of products. Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree with an expected graduation date between December 2026 and June 2027 . Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship. Preferred qualifications Master’s degree in Material Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Optics, Physics, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Software Engineering, Modeling Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science, RF Engineering, Plasma Engineering, Plasma Physics, Nuclear Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or any related field. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Ads Console Frameworks
jobs.description: We're building the platform that powers the Amazon Ads Console — the framework layer that drives development velocity, latency, and availability improvements for tens of product teams building advertising experiences. As the console transitions toward agentic, AI-driven workflows, we need a Senior SDE to lead the technical evolution of our platform and the new systems that will underpin this shift. The Ads Console Frameworks team owns Pantheon (the app framework powering the console's architecture), Argus (an agentic quality evaluation platform that autonomously walks advertiser workflows to detect regressions), Compass (a self-serve product analytics platform for the console), and the shared services and components that every Ads Console page depends on. Our systems serve as the foundation dozens of teams build on. This is not a heads-down coding role. You'll drive architectural decisions with broad ambiguity — designing how the console's frameworkS evolve to support agentic development patterns, defining how product analytics should work across 141 pages, and shaping platform contracts that other teams adopt. You'll need strong product instincts to understand advertiser workflows and form a point of view on where framework-level solutions unlock the most leverage, and either bring knowledge of the advertising business or the curiosity to develop it quickly. The role spans technically complex domains — from front-end framework architecture and module systems, through platform services targeting 99.99% availability under peak load, to AI agent orchestration, evaluation systems, and governed data pipelines. You'll also be expected to embrace and advance AI-native development practices, using AI tools and agentic coding techniques to accelerate how the team builds software. This is a horizontal team role: you set technical direction that other teams build on, define API contracts and integration patterns across organizational boundaries, and maintain platform quality as adoption scales rapidly. The right candidate has designed and built platform systems at scale, can operate independently in highly ambiguous problem spaces, has recent hands-on experience with AI-powered or agent-oriented systems, and brings product thinking to every technical decision. Key job responsibilities - Lead technical architecture and hands-on delivery across the full AI application stack — UI, services, agent infrastructure, orchestration, and evaluation — for the Ads Agent experience and integration framework used by dozens of partner teams. - Bring product thinking to every technical decision: develop deep understanding of advertiser workflows so architecture choices reflect how advertisers actually use the product. - Set architectural direction on a horizontal platform team: define integration patterns and API contracts that dozens of teams build on, lead design reviews, and maintain quality as adoption scales. - Establish and exemplify best practices for building AI applications (evaluation methodologies, quality guardrails, prompt engineering, orchestration patterns) and for AI-native development (using AI tools and agentic coding to accelerate the team's delivery). - Drive operational excellence and mentor engineers across the team. A day in the life You start the day reviewing agent quality metrics and system health across the stack. Mid-morning you're leading a design review for a new framework capability — asking sharp questions that blend technical depth with product thinking about advertiser workflows. After lunch you're writing high-leverage code: the interface for a new extension point that partner teams will build on. Later you join a cross-team architecture discussion on whether a new capability should be a skill or a separate agent, driving alignment by making tradeoffs concrete. You close the day refactoring a service that grew complex during prototyping — because on a horizontal team, accumulated complexity compounds with every partner. About the team We are a team of ~50 engineers building the experience layer for the Amazon Ads Agent and Console. We own the chat interface, advertiser-facing communications, and the frameworks that enable dozens of partner teams to integrate agent capabilities across the Ads Console. This is a horizontal team — our APIs, patterns, and quality bar ripple across the organization. We're at an inflection point on two fronts: the product we build is an AI agent, and our development workflow is shifting to AI-native practices using agentic coding. Both are core to how we operate.
